DW.walk: async function walk(dir,out,depth){out=out||[];depth=depth||0;if(depth>6)return out;for await(const e of dir.values()){if(e.kind==='file'){if(/\.(flac|mp3|wav|aiff|m4a|ogg)$/i.test(e.name))out.push(await e.getFile());}else if(e.kind==='directory')await walk(e,out,depth+1);}return out;}
DW.dedupe: function dedupe(c){const key=t=>t.name.toLowerCase().replace(/^[^-]+-\s*/,'').replace(/^[^-]+-\s*/,'').replace(/^\d+\s*/,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');const seen=new Map();for(const t of c){const k=key(t);if(!k)continue;if(!seen.has(k)||seen.get(k).conf<t.conf)seen.set(k,t);}return [...seen.values()];}
DW.confidence: confidence(){if(!corpus.length)return 'empty';const c=corpus.map(t=>t.conf).sort((a,b)=>a-b);const med=c[c.length>>1];return{median:+med.toFixed(3),weak:corpus.filter(t=>t.conf<1).length,strong:corpus.filter(t=>t.conf>=2).length,of:c.length,note:'Essentia scale 0-5.32; 1.5-3.5 moderately confident. NOT comparable to another detector.'};}

DW_LIB.pick: async pick(){if(!window.showDirectoryPicker)throw new Error('showDirectoryPicker unavailable (Chromium only)');this.dir=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'read'});const f=await walk(this.dir);this.files=new Map();for(const x of f)this.files.set(norm(x.name),x);return this.files.size;}
DW_LIB.decode: async decode(m,ctx){const f=this.find(m);if(!f)throw new Error('missing file: '+m.name.slice(-32));return ctx.decodeAudioData(await f.arrayBuffer());}

globals.__measure: async function(file){const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;const ac=new AC(),buf=await ac.decodeAudioData(await file.arrayBuffer());const sr=buf.sampleRate;const off=new OfflineAudioContext(1,buf.length,sr);const s=off.createBufferSource();s.buffer=buf;const lp=off.createBiquadFilter();lp.type='lowpass';lp.frequency.value=150;const hp=off.createBiquadFilter();hp.type='highpass';hp.frequency.value=30;s.connect(lp);lp.connect(hp);hp.connect(off.destination);s.start(0);const low=(await off.startRendering()).getChannelData(0);let pk=[],thr=.95;while(pk.length<30&&thr>.15){pk=[];let i=0;while(i<low.length){if(low[i]>thr){pk.push(i);i+=Math.round(sr*.25);}else i++;}thr-=.05;}const ct={};for(let i=0;i<pk.length;i++)for(let j=1;j<11&&i+j<pk.length;j++){let b=60/((pk[i+j]-pk[i])/sr);while(b<90)b*=2;while(b>180)b/=2;const k=Math.round(b);ct[k]=(ct[k]||0)+1;}let bpm=0,best=0,tot=0;for(const k in ct){tot+=ct[k];if(ct[k]>best){best=ct[k];bpm=+k;}}const d=buf.getChannelData(0);let sum=0,zc=0,st=Math.max(1,Math.floor(d.length/200000));for(let i=st;i<d.length;i+=st){sum+=d[i]*d[i];if((d[i]>=0)!==(d[i-st]>=0))zc++;}const n=Math.floor(d.length/st);ac.close();return{name:file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''),buf,bpm,conf:tot?+(best/tot).toFixed(3):0,rms:Math.sqrt(sum/n),zcr:zc/n,dur:+buf.duration.toFixed(1),energy:0,art:null};}
globals.__walk: async function(dir,out,depth){out=out||[];depth=depth||0;if(depth>6)return out;for await(const e of dir.values()){if(e.kind==='file'){if(/\.(flac|mp3|wav|aiff|m4a|ogg)$/i.test(e.name)){const f=await e.getFile();out.push(f);}}else if(e.kind==='directory'){await window.__walk(e,out,depth+1);}}return out;}

async function(){if(!window.showDirectoryPicker)return 'showDirectoryPicker unavailable — chromium only';const dir=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'read'});window.__UI2.say('◇ SCANNING FOLDER','walking the tree…');const files=await window.__walk(dir);window.__corpus=[];let n=0,cached=0,fail=0;for(const f of files){n++;window.__UI2.prog(n,files.length,f.name);try{const r=await window.__analyse(f);if(r.cached)cached++;window.__corpus.push(r);}catch(e){fail++;console.warn(f.name,e.message);}}
window.__normalise();return{files:files.length,analysed:window.__corpus.length,cached,failed:fail};}
globals.__loadSet:
async function(){const dir=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'read'});const files=await window.__walk(dir);const nm=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');const picked=[];for(const target of window.__SET){const f=files.find(x=>nm(x.name).includes(nm(target.split(' - ').pop()))&&(target.includes('Home Arcade')?/home arcade/i.test(x.webkitRelativePath||x.name)||true:true));if(f)picked.push({target,file:f});}
return picked.map(p=>p.file.name.slice(0,55));}
globals.__beatNear: function beatNear(track,t){const b=track.beats;if(!b||!b.length)return t;let best=b[0],d=1e9;for(const x of b){const dd=Math.abs(x-t);if(dd<d){d=dd;best=x;}}return best;}
globals.__downbeatNear: function downbeatNear(track,t){const b=track.beats;if(!b||b.length<4)return beatNear(track,t);let best=b[0],d=1e9;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i+=4){const dd=Math.abs(b[i]-t);if(dd<d){d=dd;best=b[i];}}return best;}
globals.__runMix:
async function(){const dir=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'read'});const files=await window.__walk(dir);const nm=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');const order=['carrierwave','bootloader','pixelcrush','chiptuneride','copypartymemories','touchingthesky','magn','199x'];const C=window.__corpus;const set=[];for(const key of order){const meta=C.filter(x=>nm(x.name).includes(key)).sort((a,b)=>b.conf-a.conf)[0];if(!meta){console.warn('no meta',key);continue;}const file=files.find(f=>nm(f.name)===nm(meta.name)+nm(f.name.slice(f.name.lastIndexOf('.'))) || nm(f.name).startsWith(nm(meta.name)));if(!file){console.warn('no file',key,meta.name);continue;}set.push({meta,file});}
return set.map(s=>s.meta.name.slice(0,50));}
globals.__runMixResolve: async function(){const dir=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'read'});const files=await window.__walk(dir);const nm=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');const order=['carrierwave','bootloader','pixelcrush','chiptuneride','copypartymemories','touchingthesky','magntique','199x'];const C=window.__corpus;const set=[];const seen=new Set();for(const key of order){const meta=C.filter(x=>nm(x.name).includes(key)).sort((a,b)=>b.conf-a.conf)[0];if(!meta){console.warn('no meta for',key);continue;}const file=files.find(f=>nm(f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''))===nm(meta.name));if(!file){console.warn('no file for',meta.name);continue;}if(seen.has(meta.name))continue;seen.add(meta.name);set.push({meta,file});}window.__SETRESOLVED=set;return set;}
globals.__loadEight: async function(){const H=window.__WH;try{H.st.textContent='pick the folder...';const set=await window.__runMixResolve();if(!set.length){H.st.textContent='no files matched';return 'none';}const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;const tmp=new AC({sampleRate:44100});const loaded=[];for(let i=0;i<set.length;i++){H.st.textContent='decoding '+(i+1)+'/'+set.length;const buf=await tmp.decodeAudioData(await set[i].file.arrayBuffer());loaded.push({meta:set[i].meta,buf:buf});}tmp.close();window.__P.load(loaded);window.__drawJump();H.st.textContent=loaded.length+' loaded - press play';return loaded.length+' loaded';}catch(e){H.st.textContent='failed: '+(e.message||e);console.error(e);return 'failed';}}
globals.__exportMix: async function(from,to,name){const H=window.__WH;try{H.st.textContent='rendering offline...';const buf=await window.__render({from:from,to:to});H.st.textContent='rendered '+buf.duration.toFixed(0)+'s - encoding flac 0%';const blob=await window.__toFlac(buf,p=>{H.st.textContent='encoding flac '+Math.round(p*100)+'%';});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=(name||'lukhash-mix')+'.flac';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),20000);H.st.textContent='saved '+(blob.size/1048576).toFixed(1)+'MB flac';return {seconds:+buf.duration.toFixed(1),mb:+(blob.size/1048576).toFixed(1)};}catch(e){H.st.textContent='export failed: '+(e.message||e);console.error(e);throw e;}}
globals.__centroid:
function(freq,sr2){let num=0,den=0;for(let i=1;i<freq.length;i++){const m=freq[i]/255;num+=i*m;den+=m;}
 if(!den)return 0;const bin=num/den;return bin*(sr2/2)/freq.length;}
